purpose: C版老板娘面部局部美化与像素颗粒纠正；仅预览，未替换游戏素材

steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY THE FACE of the WHITE-HAIRED SHOPKEEPER on the far left in this selected C-version pixel-art character sheet. The user likes this exact coarse pixel style and realistically proportioned adult bodies; her face needs to be more beautiful, charismatic and memorable.
Make her an attractive adult harbor shop owner with a warm, intelligent, confident expression. Refine the existing face using the SAME large square pixel grid: graceful softly arched brows instead of heavy blunt marks, subtly almond-shaped natural-sized eyes with warm hazel irises and one restrained highlight, clear upper lash contour (not heavy makeup), a softer well-balanced cheek-to-chin contour, a delicate implied nose, a softly curved rose-colored smile with a tiny confident asymmetry. A restrained warm cheek tone. Preserve her age, identity, head size, gaze direction and head angle. Charm should come from eye expression and confident gentle smile, not giant anime eyes or a baby face. Keep the adult neck/shoulder proportions.
ABSOLUTELY PRESERVE: her white/silver hair silhouette, side braid, teal scarf, cream blouse, brown vest, brass compass pin, apron, paper inventory, hands, pose and body; HANK, ADA, MILO completely unchanged; all background, layout, labels, C marker and canvas dimensions unchanged. Only localized face pixels of leftmost woman may change.
Use coherent coarse square pixel clusters at the SAME grain as input, 3-4 skin tones, crisp stepped edges, no airbrushing, no photographic face, no glossy AI beauty rendering, no smooth vector illustration, no tiny detailed face pasted into a low-res body. No jewelry additions, no new costume, no cleavage changes. Keep everything outside the face untouched.

Localized correction ONLY to far-left white-haired woman's face in this sheet. The new attractive eye expression and smile are good, but her face is now drawn with smooth thin lines and is TOO HIGH RESOLUTION for the coarse pixel body. REDRAW HER FACE WITH THE SAME BIG SQUARE PIXEL GRID AS THE OTHER THREE FACES. Keep the beautiful confident expression, elegant arched brows, warm amber eyes, softly smiling lips and adult face proportions, but express those with a few solid coarse pixel clusters. Her entire visible face from brow to chin should have roughly 18 logical pixel rows, uniformly enlarged into obvious approximately 6x6 pixel blocks. Eyebrows stepped 1-pixel thick clusters, eyelid 3-4 pixels across with one dark amber iris pixel plus restrained highlight, mouth 3-4 rose pixels across, jaw stair-step outline with NO smooth black curves. Three flat skin shades. No individual eyelashes, eyeliner wings, tiny nose drawing, smooth gradients, or glossy anime face. The face should be visually as pixelated as Ada and Milo on this exact sheet. Preserve the woman's hair, clothing, body, pose, head size; preserve EVERY OTHER part of the sheet and the other three people. Only redraw this face patch. Do not change names, background, layout or image dimensions.
